description: This file contains functions and logic for downloading, extracting, and installing skill archives within a project, including path resolution, archive type detection, and network fetch handling.

methods.name: isNodeReadableStream
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a NodeJS.ReadableStream.

methods.name: resolveDownloadTargetDir
methods.description: Resolves the target directory for download, ensuring it stays within the skill tools root.

methods.name: resolveArchiveType
methods.description: Determines the archive type based on filename extension or explicit spec.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles downloading a file from a URL to a specified directory with progress and cleanup.

methods.name: installDownloadSpec
methods.description: Main exported function to download, optionally extract, and install a skill archive based on provided specifications.
